user.title: Create grow space
user.description: Create one config entry per grow space.

entity_mapping.title: Map entities
entity_mapping.description: Bind a LocalTuya/Tuya Local water monitor when available. Cloud Tuya polling is an optional fallback. Map canopy air sensors for VPD yourself.

data.temperature: Air temperature sensor (canopy, used for VPD)
data.humidity: Air humidity sensor (canopy, used for VPD)
data.rdwc_pump: RDWC circulation pump (REQUIRED for header bucket dosing workflow; always run before dosing)
data.water_monitor_device_id: Local water monitor (LocalTuya or Tuya Local)

ai_provider.title: AI provider
ai_provider.description: Select provider for this grow space.

ai_credentials.title: Provider credentials
ai_credentials.description: Enter credentials and discover available models.

error.duplicate_name: A grow space with this name already exists.
error.invalid_base_url: Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.model_discovery_failed: Model discovery failed. Retry or enter a model manually.

init.title: Grow space settings
init.description: Update mappings and settings. Prefer a LocalTuya/Tuya Local water monitor; cloud Tuya is fallback-only.

data.temperature: Air temperature sensor (canopy, used for VPD)
data.humidity: Air humidity sensor (canopy, used for VPD)
data.rdwc_pump: RDWC circulation pump (REQUIRED for header bucket dosing workflow; always run before dosing)
data.water_monitor_device_id: Local water monitor (LocalTuya or Tuya Local)

set_pump.name: Set pump
set_pump.description: Control a mapped pump (on, off, or toggle).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: The TendrilGrow config entry ID containing the pump mapping.

pump.name: Pump
pump.description: The pump role (rdwc_pump, chiller_pump, or air_pump).

action.name: Action
action.description: The action to perform (on, off, or toggle).

mark_flush.name: Mark reservoir flush
mark_flush.description: Record that a full reservoir flush and refill was just completed. RDWC reservoirs are typically flushed every 7-10 days; press 'Flush Now' (or call this service) right after flushing so days-since, next-due, and the overdue reminder stay accurate.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: The TendrilGrow config entry ID whose reservoir was flushed.

capture_timelapse_frame.name: Capture timelapse frame
capture_timelapse_frame.description: Capture one timelapse frame now for one or all loaded grow spaces.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional specific TendrilGrow config entry ID to capture. Leave empty to capture for all loaded entries.

build_timelapse.name: Build timelapse video
build_timelapse.description: Build a timelapse video from captured frames for a grow space using ffmpeg.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: The TendrilGrow config entry ID to build a timelapse video for.

ai_no_camera.title: TendrilGrow: map a camera for AI health checks
ai_no_camera.description: An AI provider is selected for {grow_space}, but no camera entity is mapped. Map a camera in the TendrilGrow options so AI vision health checks can run.

ai_no_model.title: TendrilGrow: choose an AI model
ai_no_model.description: An AI provider is selected for {grow_space}, but no model is chosen. Open the TendrilGrow options and pick a model (or enter one manually) so AI health checks can run.

timelapse_not_allowlisted.title: TendrilGrow: allow-list your timelapse directory
timelapse_not_allowlisted.description: Timelapse capture for {grow_space} failed because the directory is not allow-listed. Add {path} to homeassistant.allowlist_external_dirs, then capture a frame again to resume scheduling.
